title: Arcane Hot Shot
summary: Arcane Hot Shot is an Arcane Enhancement for the Warframe that increases weapon Critical Chance for 10 seconds when using abilities to inflict  Heat Status Effects on enemies.
extract:
Arcane Hot Shot is an Arcane Enhancement for the Warframe that increases weapon Critical Chance for 10 seconds when using abilities to inflict  Heat Status Effects on enemies.

Effect

Acquisition
A single copy can be bought each week from Kaya Velasco in Höllvania Central Mall for 5  Pix Chip.
As a random reward from Temporal Archimedea.
With a 1.67% chance, it can be acquired for 200 Vosfor in Loid’s Höllvania Arcane Collection.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Abilities that apply a  Heat proc will produce a stack of Hot Shot each time an enemy is afflicted by an instance of  Heat status. Abilities repeatedly afflict  Heat will produce a new stack for each instance. Sources include:
Warframes with abilities that directly inflict  Heat status effects, such as  Ember,  Nezha,  Protea,  Uriel,  Gauss,  Wisp and  Temple
Warframes with  Heat-moddable Exalted Weapons, such as  Mesa,  Valkyr,  Cyte-09,  Jade, and  Hildryn, plus others
Warframes which have received subsume abilities from the Helminth that can inflict  Heat, including:
 Jade Stars from  Sirius & Orion
 Thermal Sunder from  Gauss
 Fire Walker from  Nezha
 Fire Blast from  Ember
 Ophanim Eyes from  Jade
 Null Star from  Nova with the  Neutron Star augment
Warframes with abilities that apply many status effects, such as  Citrine,  Koumei and  Voruna
Warframes with variable-element configurations, such as  Lavos and  Chroma
Warframes that make  Heat-inflicting traps, such as  Follie and  Mirage
The Atomicycle's   Atomi-Barrage and   Atomi-Bomb also stack the buff.
Though some enemies have a capped number of status effects they can receive, such as Bosses and Adversaries, applying a  Heat proc to an enemy at max procs will still cause Hot Shot to refresh and stack.
Stacks are granted and refreshed even on fatal damage instances that apply  Heat.
An important distinction is that stacks are created per infliction of  Heat status, not per proc (i.e., applying two or more procs of Heat at once to one enemy grants only one stack).
 Archon Vitality does not provide any benefit for this Arcane.
Hot Shot is not stacked by abilities that simply add  Heat elemental damage to weapons, such as  Cyte-09's  Resupply or  Uriel's buff from Vythelas.
It is also not stacked by applying  Heat via the parkour mod  Firewalker or the Hound precept  Focused Prospectus, although the  Electricity-applying Precept  Synergized Prospectus does stack if it has been co-equipped with  Manifold Bond and a  Heat-modded Hound weapon.
Critical Chance bonus applies to all weapon types.
This applies to primary, secondary, and melee weapons, as well as Archguns in the Heavy Weapon slot.
Bonus does not apply to Necramech weapons, but does apply to Archguns when wielded by Archwings.
However, since no Archwing abilities can inflict  Heat status effects, the procs would have to come from Warframe abilities.
Bonus is additive to mods such as  Point Strike,  Pistol Gambit and  True Steel.
Applies as a Universal Weapon Bonus, although most weapon-coded abilities have 0% critical chance, and thus cannot make use of the arcane.
Works with  Minelayer Flechette, but not  Breach Surge.
All stacks of the buff expire simultaneously at the end of the 10 second duration. Applying a new stack refreshes the buff duration.
Hot Shot's duration is identical to the 10 second duration of  Cascadia Flare's buff, which is also triggered by  Heat status infliction.
However, it is shorter than status-triggered Arcanes for other types, such as  Primary Frostbite,  Primary Blight and  Conjunction Voltage, all of which have 12 second duration.
Trading Arcane Hot Shot requires the trader to be Mastery Rank 11 or higher.

Tips
Hot Shot can be stacked quickly by abilities that apply  Heat repeatedly, such as a lingering field like  Fire Walker or the rapid-firing  Blaze Artillery, or to many enemies at once, like  Thermal Sunder. It can be stacked very quickly by abilities that do both, such as  Uriel's  Infernalis or  Ember's  Inferno.
The Helminth-subsumable ability  Jade Stars from  Sirius & Orion launches motes capable of inflicting multiple  Heat procs per second, making any  Jade Stars-infused frame capable of producing enough  Heat procs to build and maintain a powerful Hot Shot buff.
 Nezha's  Fire Walker ability, also Helminth-subsumable, produces trails of fire that lock enemies into an Ignite animation loop while continually applying  Heat procs.
A  Diriga with  Arc Coil or  Electro Pulse and a Hound with  Synergized Prospectus are able to activate Arcane Hot Shot very reliably with  Manifold Bond and a weapon modded for  Heat.
Exalted Weapons modded for  Heat can quickly acquire and maintain stacks of Hot Shot.
If a secondary Exalted Weapon is modded for  Heat, there is multi-point synergy from Arcane Hot Shot with  Cascadia Flare and the  Topaz Archon Shard buff for secondary critical chance on  Heat kills.
 Cascadia Flare has overlapping activation conditions with Hot Shot, and the Topaz Archon Shard buff is stacked by killing  Heat-afflicted enemies. This means that all three buffs can be activated and maintained with minimal changes to a playstyle already making use of Hot Shot.
This trifecta produces a combined 480% base damage bonus and up to a maximum 675% bonus critical chance for secondary weapons.
